---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

The scatter plot below @fig-budget-revenue plots each film's production budget against its revenue.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Production budget against revenue (million US$)"

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (million US$)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million US$)")
plt.show()
```
